audit.why: Emerald+ win rate 53.32% over 557 games and a level chart that is Gragas in all seven rows agree with FAV / 4-10 difficulty. No stage flip is justified: Gragas out-ranges Locke's melee-range W (250) and E (425) with Barrel Roll at 850, and Drunken Rage's flat 5s damage reduction blunts his on-hit passive chip. Level 6 is the only genuine narrowing, and the chart already drops to 6/10 there.
audit.corrected: Chart left as Gragas 7 stages; ratings unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had only 3 entries (packet defect), and the level-6 spike text did not name the actual mechanic Cask beats.
audit.why: Gragas' own hard spike at Q max is absent: Barrel Roll goes 10s to 6s cooldown across ranks, which is what makes the chip permanent against a champion whose only sustain is the delayed self-refund on W (18/17/16/15/14s). Locke's R is 120/100/80 with an execute threshold and a grounding flag; Explosive Cask's knockback is the tool that removes him from that zone, and Gragas' R is 100/85/70 so the numbers make the trade concrete.
audit.corrected: Added spikes[3] for Q max at level 9 (6s Barrel Roll); rewrote spikes[1] to state the knockback-out-of-execute-zone interaction with the 100s ult cost.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive R-vs-E interaction was never stated: Locke's ultimate carries a grounding flag, which disables Body Slam inside the zone. The pages only talked about the execute threshold.
audit.why: Grounded means Gragas cannot dash out with Body Slam (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) once he is inside Locke's ult, so the correct instruction is to walk out rather than plan a dash escape, and to use Explosive Cask's knockback to displace Locke instead. Locke's E is a 10s flat cooldown teleport-dash and his only mobility, which makes the post-E window the honest engage window.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the grounding; whys[4] states it; phases[1].why now carries the real 10s E cooldown.

audit.why: The pages already centre the post-E window, and the kit confirms E is a flat 10s at every rank and his sole mobility.
